setup.tempRepo: empty directory, no git init required

cases.notes: Exercises resolve_new_path: rel_path.trim() is checked for emptiness first, so an all-whitespace name ('   ') hits 'name cannot be empty' rather than the component check. A '..' component is rejected in the second check because it is not Component::Normal (the 'invalid path: {rel_path}' message interpolates the original, untrimmed argument) — independent of whether anything canonicalizes, since the target doesn't exist yet. This is the creation-time guard, distinct from resolve_within_repo used by read/write/move.
